In [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]], [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Kentor Sarne]] deployed a '''''Carrack''-class light cruiser''' to [[Tanquilla Beach/Legends|''Tanquilla Beach'']]. The [[Captain/Legends|captain's]] [[Skirmish at Tanquilla Beach|mission]] was to strike at the [[Corvette/Legends|corvette]] ''[[FarStar]]'' and then retreat into [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]]. Unfortunately, Sarne was unaware of the extent of ''Tanquilla Beach''{{'s}} armaments, and the [[Carrack-class light cruiser/Legends|''Carrack'']] was destroyed when faced with the ''Beach''{{'s}} defenses and the ''FarStar''.
